verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official, documented CLI (bru-cli). It runs collections from the command line [bruno-docs-1, bruno-probe-3] and produces machine-readable JSON, JUnit and HTML reports [bruno-docs-2]. It also supports CI/CD and official Docker images [bruno-docs-3, bruno-docs-18, bruno-docs-30], runtime flags such as --global-env-var [bruno-docs-11], and a sandbox-mode flag [bruno-docs-61], so agents or scripts can drive it non-interactively. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and explicit documentation of driving the CLI from AI agents (the agent integrations shown focus on editing collection files).
